name: 0x2f
description: A local work router for coding agents. Tasks persist across runs, so a task can be continued through a different harness without losing prior results or decisions.

scripts.check: find src test relay scripts deploy -name node_modules -prune -o \( -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.js' \) -exec node --check {} \; && python3 -c "import ast,glob,sys; [ast.parse(open(f, encoding='utf-8').read(), f) for f in glob.glob('test/tui-pty/*.py')]"
